notes: LoRA adapter-config derivation from model cards for causal networks: LoRA rank/alpha (with CLI overrides), dropout, lexicographically sorted target_modules restricted to trainable non-head Linear/Conv1D modules, modules_to_save for the head (head+frozen excluded entirely), and the fixed causal-LM fields (task_type CAUSAL_LM, bias none, base_model_name_or_path, inference_mode). Hard elements are the precedence rules (frozen beats head), Conv1D inclusion, h.10-vs-h.2 lexicographic ordering, empty-target cards, and override semantics. Verifier re-executes the generator on three hidden cards with distinct module sets and flag combinations.
